goal.note: Strategy: train for 3:30 so that a rough day still banks 3:45 and a bad day stays under 4:00. Race date assumed 2027 - edit if different.

zonesNote: Zones are anchored to CURRENT fitness (threshold ~5:15/km, from real runs - 10.4km @5:17 HR162, benchmark 4:54 @HR149), not to the goal. They only move when the data says so: the dashboard checkpoint banner proposes new zones after a faster 5K/10K/half, and the Build-phase test half recalibrates everything. Reference: 3:30 marathon shape eventually needs threshold ~4:50/km - the plan walks you there via evidence, never by decree. Coach's rule: threshold must FEEL sustainable 50-70 min; if a rep cooks you, it was too fast.

schedule.comment: JS day numbers: 0=Sunday 1=Monday ... 6=Saturday. Wed+Sat are no-run days.

races.name: Leopoldilauf Halbmarathon
races.title: RACE — Leopoldilauf Half (baseline)
steps: Job: honest baseline, 23 weeks out — information, not glory. You come off a cutback week; no extra taper
Warm-up: 3 km very easy + drills + 4 strides, timed to finish ~10 min before the 10:00 gun
Loop 1 (7 km) @ 5:30/km — must feel embarrassingly easy
Loop 2 (7 km) @ 5:20/km — settle in and work
Loop 3 (7 km) @ 5:10/km or faster on feel — earn the finish · ≈1:52:30 (band 1:52–1:55)
Fuel: breakfast 2 h before · water + salt only · nibble ~10 g carbs from 10 min before, ~40 g/h during
Cool-down 1–2 km jog · next 2–3 days easy — the recovery ladder applies

races.name: Adventlauf 10k
races.title: RACE — Adventlauf 10k (THE checkpoint)
steps: Job: the season's honest fitness checkpoint — 3 easy days before, then race it properly
Warm-up: 3 km easy + drills + 4 strides
Km 1–3 @ 5:05/km — controlled, breathing quiet
Km 4–7 @ 4:58/km — goal marathon pace, locked
Km 8–10 @ 4:48/km — empty the tank · ≈49:30 (band 49:30–51:00) · sub-50 = goal MP held for 10 km
Fuel: breakfast 2 h before · water + salt · nibble from 10 min before the gun
Cool-down 2–3 km very easy · the result recalibrates your zones

races.name: San Silvestre Vallecana 10k
races.title: RACE — San Silvestre 10k (fun, hard)
steps: Job: hard festive effort — race on EFFORT; the crowd decides what the clock says
Evening race: main meal ~14:00, light carb snack 2 h before, nibble from 10 min before
Warm-up: 2–3 km easy + strides, as space allows
First 5 km: controlled ~5:00/km effort — don't fight the crowd, surf it
Second 5 km: build 4:55 → 4:45 — pass people all the way · 48:30–50:30 with clear road
Enjoy it — finishing the year racing is the point. Sunday's long run after this: short and genuinely easy

races.name: Eisbärlauf Halbmarathon
races.title: TEST RACE — Eisbärlauf Half
steps: The Build-phase exam — this result decides the Specific phase and recalibrates every zone
Warm-up: 3 km easy + drills + 4 strides
Loop 1 (7 km) @ 5:05/km — patient
Loop 2 (7 km) @ 4:57/km — the race pace of the day
Loop 3 (7 km) @ 4:48/km on courage · ≈1:44:20 · 1:44–1:46 untapered = green light for 3:30
Full race rehearsal: breakfast 2 h before · water + salt · nibble from −10 min · 40–60 g carbs/h · race shoes
Cool-down 1–2 km · then the recovery ladder: walk days → test jog → gym re-engagement
